fields.acceptance: goreleaser check passes on .goreleaser.yaml; a CI step runs goreleaser release --snapshot --clean on pull requests that touch it and produces all four archives; the release job's trigger is only v* tags
fields.statement: A v* tag runs a GitHub Actions release job that builds rhiza with GoReleaser for linux and darwin on amd64 and arm64 and publishes the archives and a checksums file to a GitHub release

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestVersion covers the ldflags and module-version paths, and .goreleaser.yaml sets -X main.version from the tag
fields.statement: rhiza version prints the release tag (v0.1.0) for a GoReleaser build and the module version for a go install build

fields.acceptance: a CI step runs go install ./cmd/rhiza into a fresh GOBIN with -mod=readonly and runs rhiza version; go.mod has no replace directives
fields.statement: go install github.com/dphaener/rhiza/cmd/rhiza@<version> builds a working rhiza: go.mod's module path matches the repository and nothing needs a replace directive or a private dependency
